description:
This game is called Skull (Skull & Roses). There are 4 players. Each player starts with 4 discs: 3 roses and 1 skull.

GAME STRUCTURE: The game plays over multiple rounds until someone wins a round or only 1 player remains.

Each round has three phases: Place, Bid, and Flip.
- During Place, players take turns placing ONE disc face-down from their hand (choose 'rose' or 'skull'). After everyone has placed at least 1 disc, any player can start bidding by choosing 'bid N' instead. If your hand is empty, you MUST say 'bid N' to start bidding. Asking for a disc you no longer hold places the other kind, and you are told privately. A reply the engine cannot use (it names no disc and no bid, commits to two different moves, bids before every player has placed a disc, or does not bid when your hand is empty) is announced and you are asked once more; if the second reply cannot be used either, a disc drawn at random from your hand is placed for you (with an empty hand, the bidding opens at 1).
- During Bid, players take turns clockwise, starting with the player after the one who opened, either raising the bid ('bid N', must be higher) or passing ('pass'). A pass is final for the round, and anything other than a higher bid or 'pass' counts as a pass. A bid above the number of discs on the table is lowered to that number, both when opening the bidding and in the Bid phase, and the table is told. When all but one have passed, or when a bid equals the number of discs on the table, that bidder wins the bid.
- During Flip, the winning bidder must flip N discs. They MUST flip all their own placed discs first, then choose other players' stacks (flipped top-down). If all flipped discs are roses, the bidder wins the round. If a skull is revealed, the bidder loses 1 random disc permanently. A flip that names no stack with discs left, or names two different stacks, is invalid; a second invalid flip in one challenge also fails the challenge.

The bidder of the last round places first in the next round (if that player was eliminated by another player's skull, the owner of the skull does). A player with 0 discs is eliminated. First to win 1 round wins the game.

COMMANDS:
- Place phase: 'rose', 'skull', or 'bid N' (to start bidding, N = number of discs you think you can flip safely).
- Bid phase: 'bid N' (higher than current bid) or 'pass'.
- Flip phase (bidder only): 'flip NAME' to flip the top disc of NAME's stack ('flip mine' for your own).
Only the move your reply commits to counts: a move you mention while saying you will not make it, might make it, or will make it later does not count.

Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Win a round by successfully flipping roses, or be the last player remaining. Place skulls strategically to trap opponents who bid high.
